entities.summary: Chad is a sovereign nation in Central Africa, Africa. Its capital is N'Djamena. Official languages include French, Arabic. Government: Military transitional government (since 2021). Population: approximately 18.3 million. Area: 1,284,000 km². Comprehensive index for Chad covering Sahelian rock art, Sao civilisation, Kanem-Bornu Empire, Wadai and Bagirmi sultanates, French conquest, Tombalbaye, Libyan-Chadian conflict, Déby dynasty, and the Lake Chad environmental crisis.
